title: Book Three · Chapter 56: Fifteen Minutes
story:
On Wednesday of the second week, Anna stays after the last lesson.

“Fifteen minutes,” she tells Ronan. “Then I need to go.”

He brings out the wall question. There are three drawings on his page now. The first is crossed out. The last has a door and a window inside it.

Anna looks at the last drawing first.

“Show me your work.”

Ronan points to the numbers. He explains the large wall, then the two smaller spaces.

“I took away the door,” he says. “I haven't used the window.”

“Does that need paint?”

He looks at the question again.

“Not this paint. It says only the wall.”

He takes the pencil and crosses out the window too. Then he starts a new line of numbers.

Anna waits. When he reaches the end, she checks his first step.

“That part is right.”

“And the next?”

“Read it to me.”

He does. Halfway through, he stops. He has copied one number from the door into the window line.

“Wrong space,” he says.

He changes it and tries again. This answer is different from his first one.

Anna follows the work with her finger. Then she nods.

“Now try the second question. It uses the same idea.”

Ronan looks at the clock. Their fifteen minutes are almost gone.

“Now?”

“At home. I have to leave.”

He wants her to stay beside him for the next one. Instead, he moves his book away from her bag.

“Thank you.”

She puts her pencil away and stands up. Lin is waiting at the door with two library books.

“Tomorrow, tell me if it works,” Anna says.

The girls go downstairs together. Ronan stays to finish the line he started.

Kai comes back for his ruler. He looks at the page.

“A new house?”

“A wall. With less paint.”

Kai bends over it. “Did you do this part?”

Ronan nods. “Slowly.”

“Then I want a slow lesson too.”

“Tomorrow at lunch. One question.”

Kai grins. “One is plenty.”

At home, Ronan works through the second question. He draws the spaces before he writes the numbers.

The question also gives the space one tin of paint can cover. Ronan checks that line last. His wall needs more than one tin. He writes the number of tins beneath his drawing.

It takes longer than fifteen minutes. Once, he goes back to the first example. At the end, he has an answer he can explain from the drawing.

Dad looks over his shoulder after dinner.

“How much paint?”

Ronan tells him. Dad points to the little window.

“Good. Leave the glass clear.”

Ronan smiles and puts a small tick beside his final line. Tomorrow he has something to show Anna, and one question to try with Kai.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

take away＝减去、去掉；copy＝抄写；plenty＝足够、够多了；tick＝勾号。

## 理解问题

1. Anna怎样帮助Ronan，而没有直接替他完成计算？
2. 十五分钟结束后，两人各自做了什么？Ronan后来是否独立完成了相似题目？

## 读句子

**He draws the spaces before he writes the numbers.**

拆开看：He / draws the spaces / before he writes the numbers.

他／先画出各个区域／再写下数字。
